note: What Autopilot may do on its own. mode: auto = public changes go live without review; review = they wait in a pull request; off = the agent doesn't run. actions.emails: review = each trade email waits for /approve on Telegram; auto = approved drafts go out within limits.emailsPerDay. To stop everything: set paused to true, send /pause all to the bot, or set the AUTOPILOT_PAUSED repository variable to true.
